name: HEIC Photos
description: Indexes HEIC/HEIF photos, reads EXIF/GPS metadata, decodes tiled iPhone/Android HEICs via FFmpeg 8 stream groups, and transcodes fullscreen slideshows to 4K WebP.
overview: Full HEIC/HEIF photo and 4K browser slideshow support

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 12.4 release: 4K WebP slideshow download filter + FFmpeg 8 HEIC tile grid decoding + EXIF/GPS metadata.

name: Music Visualizer
description: Interactive fullscreen audio visualizer (Frequency Bars, Waveform, Circular Bars, 3D Rotating Spectrum, 3D Starfield, Rainbow Road) with dynamic synchronized lyrics and artist backdrop slideshow.
overview: Interactive fullscreen audio visualizer with synchronized lyrics

name: Voice Control
description: Adds a Microphone button to the top toolbar (Legacy & Modern UI) with local Whisper.net speech-to-text fallback for Tesla/Firefox/Chromium voice commands.
overview: Toolbar microphone button with local Whisper.net speech recognition

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 12.4 release with local Whisper.net speech-to-text fallback (AVX & NoAvx).

name: Music Random
description: Adds a dedicated 'Random' album discovery view to the Music library navigation in both Legacy and Modern UI.
overview: Dedicated Random album discovery view in Music libraries

versions.changelog: Initial release for Jellyfin 12.4 with responsive mobile and desktop album grid.
